edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the token sender inside transfer
msg.sender is used as the spender when updating allowances in transferFrom
recipient parameter flows into transfer
amount parameter flows into transfer
sender parameter flows into transferFrom
amount parameter flows into transferFrom
transfer invokes _transfer
transferFrom invokes _transfer
from parameter drives all checks in _transfer
to parameter drives all checks in _transfer
amount parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount in _transfer
cooldown requirement compares block.timestamp against cooldown[to]
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping
cooldown mapping state is read during the _transfer cooldown check
_owner retrieved via owner() is compared against the caller in _transfer
bots mapping is consulted to block blacklisted from/to addresses
cooldownEnabled flag gates the cooldown branch in _transfer
_maxTxAmount caps the transfer amount in _transfer
swapEnabled flag gates the automatic swap-and-send branch
inSwap guard flag is checked before the automatic swap in _transfer
_buyTax is assigned into _feeAddr2 for buy-path transfers
_sellTax is assigned into _feeAddr2 for sell-path transfers
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to select tax paths
uniswapV2Router address is compared in the _transfer exclusion checks
contractTokenBalance local is passed into swapTokensForEth
contractETHBalance local is passed into sendETHToFee
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap
_transfer calls sendETHToFee after swapping
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer which dispatches to _transferStandard
tokenAmount parameter is used as the swap input amount
uniswapV2Router is used to build the swap path and execute the swap
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call
the external Uniswap router swap can call back into the token before swap state settles
amount parameter is forwarded to the fee wallet transfer
_feeAddrWallet2 is the recipient of the ETH transfer
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to the fee wallet
the ETH transfer may trigger the recipient fallback and re-enter the token
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the full contract ETH balance
onlyOwner restricts manualswap to _owner
onlyOwner restricts manualsend to _owner
onlyOwner restricts addbots to _owner
msg.sender must equal _owner for the onlyOwner modifier on addbots
bots_ array entries are marked as bots
addbots writes true into the bots mapping
msg.sender must equal the owner for the onlyOwner modifier on openTrading
openTrading assigns the live router to uniswapV2Router
openTrading creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair address
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true
openTrading enables swapEnabled
uniswapV2Router factory/WETH are read inside openTrading
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call with contract ETH
the external router call during addLiquidityETH can re-enter the contract
onoff parameter is stored into the cooldownEnabled flag
onlyOwner restricts setCooldownEnabled to _owner
_rOwned balances are read and written in _transferStandard
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to credit the team fee
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to burn reflections
balance updates use SafeMath add/sub which can revert on failed checks
_rTotal is reduced via SafeMath sub inside _reflectFee
_getTValues performs mul/div/sub arithmetic for fee computation
_getRValues performs mul/sub arithmetic for reflection amounts
_allowances is read and decremented in transferFrom
uniswapV2Pair is used to approve the router and contextualize the swap path
